رَسُومٌ That makes marks upon the ground by the vehemence of her tread: applied to a she-camel. (S TA.) [See an ex. in a verse cited in the first paragraph of art. جهم.] ―
-b2- Also That continues journeying a day and a night: (S, K:) applied to a he-camel. (TK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
